name: Swiss Data Events
description: Swiss Data Events (swissdataevents.ch) is a curated list of upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland: meetups, conferences, workshops, networking evenings and webinars about Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, the Azure data platform, AI strategy and governance, data governance, data leadership and applied AI. Every listing is checked against the organiser's own page before it is published, and the list is refreshed every day. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.
license: Free to read, cite and link. Please link back to the event page (url) when you reuse a listing.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Onsite Hackathon Zurich
events.description: The on-site leg of the national Apertus hackathon: build on the open Apertus 8B model, strengthen its multilingual abilities and ship applications for private- and public-sector problems, with everything released as Open Commons.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Zurich Finals
events.venue: AI Startup Center, Technopark Zürich, Technoparkstrasse 1
events.description: The public closing evening of the Zurich leg of Hack Apertus: the six best teams pitch prototypes built on Switzerland’s open Apertus model, with a fireside chat with Phoeniqs, local partner introductions and an award ceremony.

events.title: Build Your Own AI Personal Assistant: No Coding Needed
events.description: A beginner-friendly Saturday workshop where you set up a personal AI assistant on your own laptop and learn to message it from your phone, with no coding required.

events.title: Coffee & Prompt #013
events.description: Relaxed weekend-morning coworking session where builders and AI-curious newcomers work on their own projects, with optional short talks and feedback rounds.

events.title: AI for Business: Network, Learn & Grow in Zurich
events.venue: ibis Styles Zurich City Center, Stampfenbachstrasse 60
events.cost: Ticket required via Eventfrog (some early-bird tickets free; drinks not included)
events.description: A deliberately small room of founders and executives comparing how they actually use AI: an invited talk, then group conversations on what worked, what failed and what they are trying next, followed by open networking.

events.title: AI Salon | Guardie e ladri — Hacker: come attaccano, come difenderci
events.organiser: AI Salon Ticino, hosted by Acer Europe
events.description: An Italian- and English-language evening in Ticino on how recent, well-known cyberattacks actually worked and how generative AI is shifting the balance between attackers and defenders, with a social-engineering quiz and a networking aperitif.

events.title: Azure Zurich AI Infrastructure Night
events.description: In-person evening at Digicomp on the infrastructure side of running AI workloads on Azure.

events.title: Databricks Executive Roundtable — Data + AI World Tour Zurich
events.cost: Not listed (Executive Program pass, apply to attend)
events.description: An invitation-based dinner and discussion for data and technology executives the evening before the Data + AI World Tour, with a welcome from Databricks leadership and a Swiss customer segment; sessions and speakers are still to be announced.

events.title: Comprendre et utiliser les intelligences artificielles génératives — Session 4
events.venue: Centre de formation FER Genève – SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4B
events.description: One-day French-language seminar on how generative AI tools work, with hands-on prompting practice for text, image, sound and video models and a look at the ethical questions.

events.title: AIristoteles 4.0 — Bis dass der Strom uns scheidet
events.organiser: HSLU Institut für Kommunikation und Marketing (IKM)
events.description: Fourth edition of HSLU’s AIristoteles series: an EPFL evolutionary psychologist and a psychotherapist discuss what it means when people enter long-term relationships with AI bots, moderated by Stephan Klapproth and followed by an apéro.

events.title: AWS Swiss User Group Bern — December Meetup
events.description: Final Bern meetup of the year for the Swiss AWS community: a mix of community talks plus discussion and networking, with the agenda announced closer to the date.

events.title: Bob TV Episode 4: Why Generic AI Fails at Mainframe Scale
events.organiser: IBM Switzerland (Data, Cloud and AI in Switzerland)
events.description: IBM’s Ethan Mendel explains why general-purpose AI models become unreliable on mainframe-scale codebases, and how static code analysis combined with metadata-enriched models makes AI dependable for modernisation work.

events.title: Databricks Data + AI World Tour Zurich 2026
events.description: Databricks' flagship Swiss stop on the Data + AI World Tour: keynotes, breakout sessions and hands-on training on Genie and Lakebase, plus an expo, with speakers from Databricks and Zurich Insurance.

events.title: Technology Briefing: Accelerating Innovation Processes with AI
events.cost: Free (all tickets taken; waiting list on the event page)
events.organiser: Empa Akademie, with CSEM and PSI
events.description: Afternoon briefing in English where researchers from Empa, CSEM and PSI and industry experts from ABB and Sulzer show how AI and automation are reshaping R&D — lab-to-fab translation, high-throughput thin-film materials discovery, innovation in expert-driven industries and low-carbon cement design — closing with an apéro.

events.title: energIA 2026 — IA & décarbonation
events.description: Second edition of the Geneva conference on AI and the energy transition, debating whether AI genuinely helps reach net zero by 2050 or mostly adds resource consumption and rebound effects, with public, private and academic participants and the Energ-IACK hackathon projects presenting their results.

events.title: Reshaping Information Research with AI
events.description: Two-hour on-site workshop from the EPFL Library comparing four AI-powered research assistants, how they work and where they differ from traditional information retrieval. Open to the public, registration required.

events.title: Global South AI Leadership Dialogue — From Inclusion to Influence
events.cost: Not listed (by invitation, request to attend)
events.description: A high-level Geneva dialogue on the place of the Global South in AI governance, convened for diplomatic missions and international organisations under the Chatham House Rule, with a written synthesis afterwards.

events.title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich — Final Edition
events.description: The closing session of IBM's 2026 hybrid series on IBM Bob, its AI development assistant — coding live alongside other European cities, with beginner, intermediate and expert tracks covering everything from first idea to modernising legacy applications.

events.title: SAIC #042: AI Is Challenging the Boundaries of Human Knowledge. Is Your Business Ready?
events.venue: Maison Internationale des Associations (MIA), Rue des Savoises 15
events.cost: CHF 5 in person (40 places, drinks and snacks included); free online
events.description: Pascal Eichenberger uses the Riemann Hypothesis as a lens on how AI is pushing the limits of human knowledge, with practical takeaways for business leaders and networking afterwards.

events.title: KI-Strategie und -Governance für KMUs
events.description: A 90-minute German-language session for SME decision-makers on steering generative AI use rather than letting it spread: setting a strategic frame, drafting an internal AI policy, weighing data-protection, liability and wrong-output risks, and planning a safe rollout under Swiss data protection law and the EU AI Act. Fifteen places.

events.title: swissICT Webinar: KI & Digital Transformation — Planung, Umsetzung, Steuerung und Wirkungsmessung
events.description: Reiner Petzold on steering AI and digital transformation programmes through KPI- and OKR-based dashboards, and why the human side — culture, roles and decision logic — decides whether the strategy delivers anything.

events.title: TechTalk #30 @ Nine — What Tools Won’t Do for You
events.description: Build-and-deploy evening at Nine: nxt Engineering on how not to wreck an Azure migration, and Access for all on why manual accessibility testing still matters alongside automated and AI-assisted checks. Also livestreamed.

events.title: Ein Team, ein Plan und viele Agenten
events.description: A German-language breakfast session with Quatico CEO Jan Wloka on why adding more AI agents tends to produce more review work than finished work, and the three changes that fixed it for his team: a written decision before any agent starts coding, work split into packages that run in parallel, and one daily overview of what needs a human. Aimed at product owners and delivery leads, with a real work package run live.

events.title: Lunch & Learn: KI-Hype bei KMU? Erstmal tief durchatmen!
events.description: Management consultant Janet Dubé on what a small or mid-sized company actually needs in place before AI pays off — which processes and data basics matter, where the quick wins are, and which early mistakes to skip.

events.title: PTO IR: The Compiler Should Place Your NPU Barriers
events.venue: ETH Zurich, CAB building, Room G51, Universitätstrasse 6
events.description: Giacomo Castiglioni of Huawei’s Computing Systems Lab on compiling for asynchronous execution units on Ascend NPUs, with a scheme that lets the compiler insert and verify synchronisation for Gated DeltaNet and FlashAttention kernels.

events.title: Webinar: KI-gestütztes Buchschreiben — die Architektur hinter «Outevolve»
events.description: Peter Beck and Andreas Schliep take their AI agent stack apart layer by layer — Obsidian as the knowledge hub, Claude Code as the engine, 50-plus skills and MCP integrations — the same production setup that wrote every line of their book, including where it falls short.

events.title: Education is Broken. Now What?
events.cost: Free (general registration full; reserved places by application)
events.organiser: Systematic-X with CH Open, Women in AI & Robotics, Women in Data Science and the Wikimedia Foundation
events.description: Day-long co-creation workshop where students, teachers, parents and tech practitioners work out what learning should look like alongside AI, data science, UX and open-source tooling; an official side event on the road to the Geneva AI Summit 2027.

events.title: Forgis Research Night — December 2026
events.description: Monthly physical-AI evening at Forgis’ headquarters: two lightning talks with Q&A — Shifeng Xie on structured-data foundation models and Forgis CTO Riccardo Maggioni on synthetic data — then an open floor with rooftop drinks.

events.title: AI in Practice: 5 Months of Real-World Experience
events.venue: UOG, The Arcade room, Rue du Cercle 2
events.description: Hydris Bessa of Gold Avenue reports on five months of rolling out AI across an engineering organisation — coding agents, automated code review and shared workflows, including what went wrong (talk in French).

events.title: 40 ans d’informatique en Valais — Conférence #3 : l’ERP, colonne vertébrale de l’entreprise, à l’ère de l’IA
events.venue: Campus Bellevue, Rte de la Plaine 2
events.organiser: HES-SO Valais-Wallis (Haute École de Gestion & Tourisme, filière Informatique de gestion)
events.description: Public French-language conference closing the 40th-anniversary series of the Valais computer-science school: Prof. Sébastien Gard on how SAP, Odoo and other ERP systems connect business functions and are changing with cloud and AI, plus braintec CEO Philipp Fux on digital transformation, followed by an apéritif.

events.title: KI-Update x swissAI Meetup — Die Auswirkungen der KI auf Kinder
events.description: Free German-language evening in Gebenstorf: a current AI update from Michael Kyburz, then Alexander Repenning on what AI means for children, closing with an apéro with the swissAI community.

events.title: Mindstone Zurich December AI Meetup
events.description: Monthly Zurich AI evening with three practical talks — building products on LLMs, getting more done with AI, and where the technology is taking work and society — followed by pizza, drinks and networking.

events.title: Neuroevolution with Geometric & ETH Zürich ASL
events.organiser: Geometric with the ETH Zürich Agentic Systems Lab
events.description: Two technical talks at ETH Zurich — one on using coding agents to deliver measurable software speedups, one on agents learning hierarchical languages and world models — plus a short introduction to the ETH Zürich Agentic Systems Lab.

events.title: Robotics Garage Night
events.description: Show-and-tell evening for people building robots: short demos of works in progress, honest accounts of what broke, then food and conversation.

events.title: Swiss IT Minds 2026 — IT, AI & Cyber Security
events.cost: Not listed (complimentary participation for qualified attendees)
events.description: Two days for Swiss IT and data leaders at the Dolder Grand on enterprise AI as a strategic capability, centralised versus decentralised AI governance in large organisations, securing AI agents as a hybrid workforce, and the governance basics behind all of it.

events.title: Switech — Founders and Innovators, Geneva Edition
events.venue: Les Halles de l’Île (address on registration)
events.cost: From CHF 8 (name your own price; free early-bird tickets gone)
events.description: Evening for Geneva founders and builders with an introduction to EPFL AI and a talk on how to build with AI without being an engineer, followed by curated introductions and networking.

events.title: AI-Roundtable — Souveräne KI in Verwaltung und Unternehmen
events.venue: BFH Departement Wirtschaft, Raum H051, Brückenstrasse 73
events.cost: Free for public administrations (registration to be announced)
events.organiser: Zentrum für Schweizerische Digitale Souveränität (Zentrum SDS) at BFH
events.description: Half-day working roundtable at the Bern University of Applied Sciences on sovereign AI in public administration and business, including a six-dimension evaluation framework for AI agent harnesses, change management and breakout groups, capped at around 50 places.

events.title: A4Q AI Foundation — Zertifizierungskurs
events.organiser: Obvious Works GmbH with Shajan Academy
events.description: A two-day German-language course leading to the A4Q AI Foundation certificate, covering how AI and machine learning systems work, where they fit in a business, and the risks and limits that come with them.

events.title: AI Forum Zürisee: Was ein Agent im Arbeitsalltag erledigt
events.description: A live look at an agentic setup that has been in daily office use for months: the agent prepares a project kick-off from a single instruction, turns a correction into a standing rule, and flags an email carrying a hidden instruction.

events.title: AI Made in Europe: Built Here. Scaled Everywhere.
events.organiser: The Founder's Story, a Google Cloud series
events.description: The season finale of Google Cloud's Founder's Story series: a panel on whether Europe can build its own global AI companies or will mostly buy AI from elsewhere, covering research, open models, compute, sovereignty and capital, followed by a networking apéro at Google's Europaallee office.

events.title: Brain2Brain Labs: BASE, une heure pour façonner votre IA
events.venue: Microcity, Rue de la Pierre-à-Mazel 39, 3rd floor
events.description: Live demonstration of BASE 2.0, AI Swiss's open standard for teaching an AI tool a team's own knowledge, working methods and rules: an hour of team discussion is transcribed, turned into instructions, sources and rules, then tested on real cases — in French, no technical background needed.

events.title: AI Tinkerers Geneva — December 2026
events.description: Around six five-minute live demos of AI tools, platforms and works in progress — no slides allowed — with a legal-tech slant for this edition, followed by networking and an apéro.

events.title: dbt Meetup Zurich
events.description: Evening for the Zürich dbt community aimed at analytics engineers, data engineers and data leaders, opening with Massimo Turola of Bank Vontobel on using dbt to manage Snowflake Cortex AI applications in an AI data catalog, then an apéro.

events.title: Podiumsdiskussion: Mensch bleiben im Zeitalter der Künstlichen Intelligenz
events.venue: Berufs- und Weiterbildungszentrum Uri, Attinghauserstrasse 12, Trakt D Aula
events.description: A German-language panel on what stays human as AI reshapes daily life, with Bishop Joseph Maria Bonnemain, HSLU philosopher Prof. Dr. Orlando Budelacci and SRF «Club» moderator Barbara Lüthi, followed by open discussion and an apéro.

events.title: AI Masterclass: 2027 Roadmap
events.venue: Atrium, Campus SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4
events.description: Free lunchtime masterclass closing FER Genève's 2026 AI series, setting out a practical 2027 roadmap for companies putting AI to work.

events.title: Business mit KI. Heute, nicht 2030. Vol. 02 — Führung ist kein Prompt
events.description: Second volume of the Lucerne series for entrepreneurs and C-level leaders on how AI reshapes teams, leadership and the job market: two short talks, a moderated panel and an apéro, capped at 50 guests and held in German.

events.title: Geneva 3D — Building a Living 3D Model of a Canton with AI Agents and Open Data
events.venue: Tesla showroom, Rue de la Confédération 8
events.organiser: Switzerland AI Community with Romandy CTO, hosted by Tesla
events.description: Arnaud Ricci on how he built Genève 3D, a browser-based 3D model of the whole canton, using AI agents and open data — with a live demonstration, questions from the room and a non-alcoholic apéro. The talk is in French with English subtitles.

events.title: IA : puissance ou prudence ?
events.organiser: Alp ICT, as part of the City of Geneva’s Semaine du climat 2026
events.description: A French-language citizen debate in Oxford style on the opportunities and risks of artificial intelligence: two teams coached by specialists argue before a jury of Geneva politicians, followed by an open discussion for SMEs and the public and an apéritif.

events.title: Unleashing the Power of MariaDB
events.venue: Swissquote Bank SA, Chem. de la Crétaux 33
events.organiser: MariaDB Swiss Group, with Swissquote and dbi services
events.description: An evening for database practitioners hosted by Swissquote: live demos and case studies on database modernisation, high availability with MaxScale, an Oracle-to-Galera migration, and pairing real-time payment workflows with in-memory caching and vector search for AI.

events.title: How Much Agent Does the Enterprise Need?
events.description: An interactive session on where enterprises genuinely need autonomous AI agents and where a deterministic AI workflow is the better answer, working through real-world cases and the trade-off between autonomy and control.

events.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — Überblick über moderne KI-Modelle
events.cost: CHF 80 for Swiss Insights individual members, CHF 120 for non-members
events.description: German-language webinar by Christoph Bräunlich, Head of AI at BSI Software, mapping today's model landscape — LLMs, multimodal models, RAG and AI agents — plus the differences between closed, open-weights and open-source models.

events.title: Workplace & Security Ninja User Group Switzerland 2612
events.organiser: Workplace & Security Ninja User Group Switzerland
events.description: Full day of community sessions on Microsoft endpoint, identity and security work, including securing agent identities, privileged-access strategy with Entra and Intune, secure low-code on the Power Platform, and label engineering.

events.title: AI Society — AI Coffee Chats Zurich (4 December)
events.description: Fortnightly drop-in coffee hour for Zurich's AI practitioners: bring a question or a workflow to show, stay for as much of the hour as you like.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Onsite Hackathon Basel
events.description: The Basel leg of the national Apertus hackathon series, building applications and multilingual improvements on Switzerland’s open Apertus model at FHNW Campus Dreispitz, with everything produced released for reuse.

events.title: Lausanne Hackathon — Swiss {ai} Weeks
events.description: An in-person hackathon where mixed teams of students, developers, startups, public-sector innovators and corporate experts build practical AI solutions to challenges set by partner organisations, open to all skill levels.

events.title: Coffee & Prompt #014
events.description: Relaxed weekend-morning coworking session where builders and AI-curious newcomers work on their own projects, with optional short talks and feedback rounds.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Basel Finals
events.description: The public closing evening of the Basel leg of Hack Apertus: the top teams pitch prototypes built on Switzerland’s open Apertus model, with a fireside chat with Phoeniqs, partner introductions from BaselTech, FHNW and ICT Scouts, and the award ceremony.

events.title: Christmas Special Hackathon — Operation Silent Night
events.description: Festive team hackathon where the Zurich Databricks User Group turns a sabotage mystery into hands-on practice with Genie, Lakebase and Databricks Apps.

events.title: AI-Stammtisch | Buchs
events.venue: OST Campus Buchs, Gebäude 1, Raum 1414 (CREALAB), Werdenbergstrasse 4
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (ICE Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.description: The Rhine valley edition of OST’s monthly AI round table: an informal evening in the Buchs CREALAB where university experts talk through how the technology actually works and how to point it at a problem you already have.

events.title: Azure Zurich User Group X-Mas Special 2026
events.description: The Azure Zürich User Group closes the year with its Christmas get-together at Frau Gerolds Wintergarten — no agenda, just food, glühwein and the Swiss Azure community. Places are limited.

events.title: KubeVirt in Practice & AI in QA: What Works, What Doesn't
events.description: Two talks in Zurich: Red Hat's Simon Krenger on running virtual machines next to containers with KubeVirt, including live demos and when it is the wrong tool, and Basia Karaagac on where AI genuinely helps in QA and where exploratory testing and human risk judgement still win.

events.title: Fabric Year in Review 2026 — Highlights & Outlook
events.organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud
events.description: Year-end session from the Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on what actually shipped in Fabric during 2026 and what is worth planning for next.

events.title: Afterwork Learn & Connect — Repenser le leadership à l'ère de l'intelligence artificielle
events.cost: Not listed (for Neuchâtel-based companies, registration by email)
events.description: A participatory French-language workshop for Neuchâtel business leaders, led by Vincent Nassar of IntoFlow, on how AI shifts management, decision-making and responsibility — each participant leaves with one concrete first step.

events.title: Votation 2032
events.organiser: Young AI Leaders — Geneva Hub, with the FNF Human Rights Hub
events.description: Role-play workshop simulating a cantonal referendum campaign on autonomous weapons, with participants using generative AI tools to build their case before a joint debrief and apéro.

events.title: AI-Lunch Basel: Brown Bag
events.description: Deliberately low-key lunch break for Basel's AI crowd: no slides and no preparation, just an open exchange of learnings and use cases across industries.

events.title: KCD Suisse Romande 2026
events.venue: CERN Science Gateway, 1 Esplanade des Particules
events.cost: Ticket required (student and job-seeker tickets CHF 49)
events.description: The second Kubernetes Community Days for French-speaking Switzerland: a warm-up day of parallel workshops with optional CERN and LHC tours, then a main day at the Science Gateway with keynotes and three tracks of talks in French and English.

events.title: Robots, Agents and the Future of Work
events.venue: Université de Fribourg, Campus de Pérolles, PER 21, Boulevard de Pérolles 90
events.description: A panel with Peter Fankhauser (co-founder and CEO of ANYbotics) and Anne Scherer (co-founder of Delta Labs) on how AI is changing company operations, from autonomous robots on the plant floor to generative AI in the boardroom.

events.title: AI-Native im Dialog — Fishbowl mit Nikolaos Kaintantzis
events.venue: Flex Meetingräume Kalkbreite, Raum Flex 1, Kalkbreitestrasse 6 (hybrid)
events.description: A German-language fishbowl discussion with SAFe Fellow Niko Kaintantzis (KEGON Schweiz) on what AI-native work means day to day — how agile roles shift, where responsibility and learning sit alongside AI, and how early experiments turn into something useful; 25 seats on site plus a live stream with English subtitles.

events.title: Webinar: Wie generative KI funktioniert
events.description: A German-language online session on how generative AI models find patterns in large datasets, why the training data shapes their answers and why confident-sounding output can still be wrong, aimed at teachers and school leaders with no technical background.

events.title: Computational Reproducibility Hackathon 2026
events.venue: Università della Svizzera italiana, Aula Polivalente, Via la Santa 1
events.organiser: Swiss Reproducibility Network (SwissRN) with USI, ETH Zurich and FernUni Schweiz
events.description: A one-day hands-on event where participants try to reproduce one another’s analyses, papers and tools, then compare notes on what makes computational work hold up; the SwissRN annual meeting follows the next day at the same venue.

events.title: AI-Powered SDLC: Zurich Tech Leaders Evening
events.description: Four practitioner talks for CTOs and engineering leaders on AI in software delivery: a year of lessons from building with AI, securing the software lifecycle against prompt injection and compromised agents, making enterprise data ready for AI agents, and AI-assisted delivery inside regulated healthcare.

events.title: Webinar: Swiss AI Impact Report 2026
events.organiser: bbv Software Services with DemoSCOPE and Hochschule Luzern
events.description: The headline findings of the third Swiss AI Impact Survey: how far Swiss companies have actually got with AI, which factors decide whether it works, and why managers and employees experience the change differently.

events.title: Rencontre avec Anne Hiltpold — IA & éducation : former aujourd’hui les compétences de demain
events.organiser: CCIG — Chambre de commerce, d’industrie et des services de Genève
events.description: Lunch meeting at the Geneva chamber of commerce where Anne Hiltpold, president of the Geneva Council of State, presents survey results on how Geneva students already use AI, followed by a discussion with businesses on what it changes for skills, jobs and training.

events.title: DevOps Talks plus Raclette
events.description: End-of-year evening for the Geneva DevOps community, opening with “Boring Data, Smart Apps: Running Business Software on MariaDB in 2027”, a possible second talk, and a raclette dinner.

events.title: Les ateliers IA — une soirée pratique pour les PME
events.description: Four parallel hands-on workshops for small and mid-sized companies — structuring team knowledge so AI tools give useful answers, responsible generative AI, being found in AI-generated answers, and managing AI risk — followed by feedback from the Cohorte IA programme and networking drinks.

events.title: The Night of Data Talents: Startup Edition
events.description: Swiss data startups pitch to an investor panel with community voting, capping the year for the Suisse Romande data scene.

events.title: Swiss Viz Awards 2026 — Award Ceremony
events.venue: HSLU Design Film Kunst, Project Space Building 745, Nylsuisseplatz 1
events.organiser: Swiss Viz Awards (Interactive Things) with Data Visualization Zurich
events.description: The Swiss Viz Awards ceremony at the Lucerne School of Design, Film and Art: a keynote from data-visualisation designer Moritz Stefaner, the awards themselves with entrants and jury in the room, then an apéro — joined by the Data Visualization Zurich community as a field trip.

events.title: Philanthropy Lunch — AI, Governance and Philanthropy
events.venue: Uni Dufour, Salle 408, Rue du Général-Dufour 24
events.organiser: Geneva Centre for Philanthropy, University of Geneva, with GAIGI — Geneva AI Governance Institute
events.description: Hybrid lunch session on the part philanthropy can play in coordinating good AI governance across international Geneva, with speakers from the University of Geneva and the Geneva AI Governance Institute.

events.title: AI Futures: Navigating the Future
events.venue: ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, Room F 26.5
events.description: Closing session of the AI Futures series, moving from grand plans to personal ones: how people actually get into AI safety work, what to do about personal finances under uncertainty, and how to handle information overload and keep your footing.

events.title: December C++ Meetup — Are We Ready for Agentic Coding Interviews?
events.description: Zürich C++ community evening at Google Europaallee, with Pavel Filonov asking whether technical interview formats still make sense now that candidates code alongside AI agents, plus snacks and socialising.

events.title: Atelier IA pour les fondations et associations philanthropiques
events.venue: Société suisse des entrepreneurs (SSE), Rue de Malatrex 14
events.organiser: Office cantonal de l'économie et de l'innovation (OCEI) with SwissFoundations and proFonds
events.description: A practical French-language morning for Geneva foundations and philanthropic associations: an introduction to the common AI tools, then guided exercises on admin work, reviewing grant applications and reporting impact, with attention to confidentiality and checking what the model produces.

events.title: Coffee & Prompt #015
events.description: Relaxed weekend-morning coworking session where builders and AI-curious newcomers work on their own projects, with optional short talks and feedback rounds.

events.title: Glühwein Workshop 2026 — Machine Learning in High-Energy Physics
events.organiser: Université de Genève (Tobias Golling group), hosted at CERN
events.description: Three-day workshop at CERN on recent machine-learning developments and how they are applied in high-energy physics, with an open call for abstracts and guided tours of the ATLAS cavern.

events.title: What if AI belonged to all of us?
events.organiser: Swiss {ai} Weeks with Kickstart Innovation and Impact Hub
events.description: Evening at Kraftwerk on whether AI should be a public good: an opening talk arguing that AI alignment cannot be top-down, a fireside chat and public deliberation on how Switzerland should build and govern its own AI, then interactive roundtables — aimed at a general audience, no technical background needed.

events.title: From Parallel Token Prediction to Scalable Language Models
events.venue: ETH AI Center Foyer, OAT X 11, Andreasstrasse 5, Oerlikon
events.description: Prof. Stephan Mandt (UC Irvine) on generating several mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass — models pretrained to 3 billion parameters that approach autoregressive quality with inference up to 5.7× faster. Hosted by Prof. Julia Vogt.

events.title: Data Fairness Community — December 2026
events.cost: For Swiss Insights corporate members (registration required)
events.description: Data-ethics community meeting at the UZH Digital Society Initiative: data-quality lessons from the City of Zurich's MeLODy chatbot and the Federal Statistical Office, a study on human-AI teaming in marketing, and the “AI Encyclical” dialogue format, followed by an apéro.

events.title: Webinar: Wie funktioniert ein Quantencomputer?
events.description: Quantum optics researcher Wolfgang Geist gives a jargon-free introduction to quantum computing — superposition, entanglement and measurement, illustrated by quantum teleportation — and sorts out where it genuinely connects to AI and where that is still research.

events.title: Von Shift Left nach Shift Values: Qualität unter AI-Native SAFe
events.description: A German-language breakfast session with SAFe trainer Thomas Verasani on quality assurance once AI writes code faster than teams can test it: what the ISTQB says about testing AI and AI-generated software, whether builders and testers should use different models, and why coverage numbers do not show value.

events.title: AI for Business: Network, Learn & Grow in Zurich
events.venue: ibis Styles Zurich City Center, Stampfenbachstrasse 60
events.cost: Ticket required via Eventfrog (some early-bird tickets free; drinks not included)
events.description: December edition of the small-room series where founders and executives compare how they actually use AI: an invited talk, group conversations on what worked and what failed, then open networking.

events.title: AI Masterclass 2027 — Session 1
events.venue: Atrium, Campus SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4
events.description: First of FER Genève's ten free lunchtime masterclasses of 2027, on how a company can get started with AI, presented by Pascal Eichenberger.

events.title: Préparer et déployer l'intelligence artificielle dans son organisation — Session 1
events.venue: Centre de formation FER Genève – SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4B
events.description: Two-day French-language seminar (12 and 19 January) on mapping business processes, using the AI Business Canvas to identify and prioritise AI projects, and leaving with a roadmap for a first deployment.

events.title: swissICT Webinar: KI-Strategie in 20 Minuten — vom Prinzip zur Priorisierung
events.description: Prof. Bramwell Kaltenrieder of BFH compares six proven approaches to AI strategy and hands over a Swiss-focused standard process, from AI ambition through use-case prioritisation to scaling, with the EU AI Act in the background.

events.title: Comprendre et utiliser les intelligences artificielles génératives — Session 1
events.venue: Centre de formation FER Genève – SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4B
events.description: One-day French-language seminar on how generative AI tools work, with hands-on prompting practice for text, image, sound and video models, aimed at communicators, marketers and entrepreneurs.

events.title: Computational Life Sciences Day 2027 — AI Agents and Real Life
events.venue: ZHAW Campus Grüental, Building GA, Grüentalstrasse 14
events.organiser: ZHAW Institute of Computational Life Sciences (ICLS)
events.description: Afternoon conference on autonomous AI agents moving from demo to production across biotechnology, healthcare, agriculture, food and environmental science, with company keynotes, ICLS research spotlights, a podium discussion and a networking apéro; registration closes 15 December 2026.

events.title: Agile Breakfast Luzern — Die agentische Organisation ist bereits Realität
events.description: Filipe Inacio of Break shows fully agentic development setups already running in Swiss companies, followed by a moderated group discussion on what is left to coach, organise and orchestrate when the agent is a team member.

events.title: Software Engineering in der Vibe-Code-Ära
events.venue: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus Rapperswil, Raum 1.213
events.cost: CHF 600 (materials, refreshments and a follow-up online clinic included)
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.description: One-day German-language course for senior engineers, tech leads and CTOs who already code with agentic tools: build your own eval suite, an MCP tool wired to your build and test commands, a CI hook that blocks bad AI patches, and a cost-per-feature model comparison — working on your own repository. Limited to 16 participants.

events.title: AI House Davos 2027
events.description: Five days of AI programming on the Davos Promenade alongside the World Economic Forum, bringing research, industry, policy and civil society together under the 2027 theme "Citizens of an expanding world".

events.title: Lunch & Learn: Täuschend echt — Deepfakes im Alltag erkennen und einordnen
events.description: Lunchtime session with AI consultant Vero Sallenbach on how deepfakes are made, why no single visual or audio tell is reliable, and a step-by-step check for source, context and cross-referencing, with a short checklist to take away.

events.title: Global Innovation Week 2027
events.venue: Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport Convention Center, The Circle 41 (18 Jan) and University of Zurich (22 Jan)
events.cost: Not announced (single sessions or full days; ticket sales opening soon)
events.description: Independently organised programme in Zurich during WEF week: a Monday on AI-ready data centres with René Raeber (Microsoft Switzerland) and Stefan Berg (Swisscom) plus roundtables on power and storage, connectivity and cooling, and defending against AI-driven attacks; a Thursday on technology and the future of capital; and a Friday dialogue on AI and trust.

events.title: AI-Stammtisch Basel: Input und Diskussion am Abend
events.venue: iRIX Software Engineering AG, Gundeldinger Feld, Bau 5, Dornacherstrasse 192
events.description: The Basel AI Stammtisch returns for the new year with a guest talk or an in-house topic, followed by open discussion over drinks at the iRIX bistro.

events.title: Davos Super Intelligence Summit 2027
events.cost: Not listed (access by invitation; invitations can be requested)
events.description: Afternoon summit during WEF week with four keynote-led panels on AGI and agentic AI, physical AI and robotics, AI infrastructure, and social impact through innovation; attendance is by invitation, which can be requested on the site.

events.title: digitalswitzerland @ Davos
events.description: A full day in Davos on Switzerland's digital future, with speakers from business, government and research building on the national AI Action Plan and looking ahead to the Geneva AI Summit 2027. Programme details still to be published.

events.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — Generating Survey Questions with LLMs
events.description: Anna Fuchs (Social Data Science and AI Lab, LMU Munich) presents a study that benchmarked five large language models and three prompting techniques against the Survey Quality Predictor, and what it says about where LLM-written items still fall short.

events.title: Davos AI Summit 2027 — The Science of New Worlds
events.organiser: Imagination in Action, in collaboration with MIT CSAIL and Stanford HAI
events.description: Tenth edition of Imagination in Action’s Davos AI Summit, running alongside the World Economic Forum, with sessions on frontier intelligence, human and machine agency and the foundations of progress.

events.title: Rethinking Cardinality & Secrets to Reliable Software
events.description: Joel Verezhak of Grafana Labs argues that fear of high-cardinality metrics is a historical habit rather than a hard limit, and shows what Parquet engines, ClickHouse and OTLP pipelines change; Dorota Parad follows on the foundations of reliable software that have nothing to do with your tech stack.

events.title: Digital Lounge @ Davos — Enterprise Data, AI & Robotics
events.description: An invitation-only forum during Davos week for CxOs and transformation leaders on enterprise data, AI and robotics — morning and afternoon keynotes and panels, a live technology showcase, entrepreneur talks and parallel workshops, closing with an awards ceremony and dinner.

events.title: Generative AI for Epidemiology Researchers: Practical Skills and Responsible Use
events.description: A three-day course in Wengen on using generative AI responsibly in research, pairing lectures with computer practicals on analysis, literature searching, scientific writing, study websites and agentic AI — and on where error, bias and reproducibility break down.

events.title: Davos Catalyst: AI Summit 2027
events.description: Invitation-only, application-reviewed one-day summit during Davos week for CEOs, AI founders and investors: keynotes on AI infrastructure, enterprise AI, sovereign AI and AI capital, pre-arranged one-to-one meetings and closing 'Deal Circles', with an optional ski day on the Saturday.

events.title: AI for Decision Makers — Executive Course at ETH Zurich
events.time: 09:00–17:00 on 22, 28 and 29 January and 4 and 5 February
events.cost: CHF 4,000 (10% off for ETH staff and alumni and SDSC partners)
events.organiser: Swiss Data Science Center / ETH Zürich School for Continuing Education
events.description: A five-day English-language executive course for leaders who need to challenge assumptions on AI projects without becoming data scientists — data science foundations, MLOps, AI governance and ethics, generative AI and a first agent, with an ETH Zurich certificate. Registration closes 15 January 2027.

events.title: 50. MEET SWISS INFOSEC! — Künstliche Intelligenz zwischen Security, Privacy und Ethik
events.description: Half-day afternoon conference on what AI can, may and should do, with Swiss AI regulation, a session on data governance and running Microsoft Copilot securely, new cyber risks in companies, and a closing ethics keynote by Prof. Peter G. Kirchschläger.

events.title: #TechDemo x skilder — l’agentisation des compétences
events.description: Half-hour live stream on Alp ICT’s channel with Nicolas Corod, founder of the Swiss start-up skilder, on turning business know-how into skills that AI assistants and agents can actually use, and how to share and govern them across an organisation.

events.title: Cloud Platforms CH — When AI Agents Become the Platform Users
events.description: The Swiss cloud-platform community spends an evening on one question: what changes when AI agents, rather than people, become the most important users of an internal platform.

events.title: Digitaltag Zentralschweiz 2027 — THE DAY AFTER
events.organiser: digitalswitzerland Zentralschweiz with Digital & AI Community
events.description: Central Switzerland’s digital day asks what remains once the AI euphoria fades — which technologies outlast a market correction, and how they reshape work, value creation, politics and the line between real and generated content, debated with voices from business, research, education and politics.

events.title: Webinar: Skill Building statt Skill Skipping
events.description: Manuel Garzi of the PH St. Gallen on why people reach for the AI shortcut, what skill skipping, cognitive offloading and deskilling do to learning, and how to keep generative AI useful rather than corrosive in teaching.

events.title: AI Village 2027
events.organiser: AI Village, a spin-off of the Swiss Cyber Storm Association
events.description: Day-long Swiss Cyber Storm spin-off bringing AI practitioners, students and security professionals together for hands-on workshops, talks, demos and a CTF challenge on where AI and cybersecurity meet.

events.title: Cloud Native Computing Meetup — January 2027
events.description: The community's first afternoon meetup of 2027, opening with runtime agent control using OpenTelemetry and OpenFeature, followed by further talks and an apéro; the Zurich venue is still to be announced.

events.title: Anticiper les risques des IA : exigences réglementaires et gouvernance
events.venue: Centre de formation FER Genève – SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4B
events.description: Two-day French-language seminar on assessing the security, governance, compliance and data-protection risks of AI solutions, covering GDPR, the AI Act and the Cyber Resilience Act and how to build a governance approach that fits an SME.

events.title: Was KI morgen kann und heute darf — interaktiver KI & Compliance Event
events.description: Morning session on using AI to capture the know-how walking out of the door with retiring staff: Prof. Andreas Lorenz (FHNW) on what AI can do for knowledge capture today, and lawyer Markus Näf on which business data may go into which kind of AI under data protection, governance and compliance rules.

events.title: swissICT Webinar: KI-Strategie in 20 Minuten — vom Prinzip zur Priorisierung (Januar-Wiederholung)
events.description: Repeat of the 20-minute AI strategy session with Prof. Bramwell Kaltenrieder of BFH: six proven approaches compared and a Swiss-focused standard process from AI ambition to use-case prioritisation and scaling.

events.title: Reading the Signals of Early 2027 — AI Governance at the Start of the Summit Year
events.cost: Not listed (by invitation, request to attend)
events.description: The fourth afterwork in GAIGI’s Road to Geneva series, reading what the first months of 2027 say about the Summit year, for diplomatic missions and civil society under the Chatham House Rule.

events.title: Generative AI & Agentische Systeme
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.description: Two-day German-language course for developers, architects, data scientists and ML engineers on building agentic LLM systems that survive production: function calling, hybrid-search RAG, LangGraph topologies, security hardening and systematic evaluation. Places are limited.

events.title: 12. F&E-Konferenz — Digitalisation, Automation and AI in Industry
events.venue: ETH Zürich, Campus Hönggerberg, HPH building
events.cost: CHF 180 members / CHF 250 non-members / CHF 60 students (excl. VAT)
events.organiser: Swissmem with SATW and Swiss Engineering, in collaboration with Innosuisse
events.description: Swiss industry research-and-development conference on digitalisation, automation and artificial intelligence, run as rapid five-minute pitches across three parallel sessions on intelligent connected products, manufacturing processes and resilient value creation.

events.title: Insomni'hack 2027
events.description: Switzerland’s largest security conference on the EPFL campus: three days of hands-on workshops from 1 to 3 February, then two conference days of talks on 4 and 5 February plus the overnight capture-the-flag contest.

events.title: SWAT4HCLS 2027
events.description: The 15th edition of the long-running international conference on semantics in healthcare and life sciences — ontologies, knowledge graphs and AI — with keynotes, tutorials and a dedicated biohackathon day in Basel.

events.title: Optimisez votre productivité avec Microsoft Copilot — Session 1
events.venue: Centre de formation FER Genève – SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4B
events.description: Hands-on French-language course on using Microsoft Copilot in everyday work — writing effective prompts and working with it in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams; a Copilot licence and a laptop are required.

events.title: Geneva AI Trade Forum 2027 (GAITF)
events.cost: Not listed (by invitation, request to attend)
events.description: The second edition of GAIGI’s high-level forum on the regulatory interoperability of AI — an opening dinner followed by a full day of dialogue for diplomatic missions, international organisations and industry.

events.title: Red Hat Summit: Connect Switzerland 2027
events.description: Red Hat's Swiss edition brings keynotes on AI, security and infrastructure choices together with four tracks on platform, AIOps and automation, security and virtualisation, plus hands-on labs, an exhibition floor and a networking apéro.

events.title: SDSC-Connect: Connecting Digital Environmental Sciences
events.venue: Central Bern venue to be announced
events.description: A day in Bern on making environmental data usable across disciplines and institutions — data access and sharing, data infrastructure, and the role of machine learning and AI across climate, ecology, hydrology, the cryosphere, natural hazards and agriculture, with keynotes, invited talks, break-outs and a poster fair. Seats are limited and the venue is still to be announced.

events.title: AI & Quantum Course: From Foundations to Scalable Intelligence
events.description: An afternoon course run with Quantum Basel, led by its CTO Jan Mikolon, bridging current AI practice and quantum technologies — from the foundations through to what it takes to scale.

events.title: AI Masterclass 2027 — Session 2
events.venue: Atrium, Campus SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4
events.description: Second of FER Genève's free 2027 lunchtime masterclasses, on how AI is changing what each job function actually does.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Midway
events.venue: Novu Campus @ The Circle, The Circle 60
events.description: The mid-series afternoon of the national Hack Apertus initiative: Imanol Schlag (ETH), Thomas Taroni (Phoeniqs) and David Gugelmann (Exeon Analytics) on the model, the infrastructure and the security, three hackathon projects showing what they built, then parallel Q&A tables and a closing reception.

events.title: swissICT Webinar: KI-Tools für mehr Effizienz — welche passen zu meinem Unternehmen?
events.description: Moritz Maier of BFH gives practical criteria for picking between ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude and the long tail of niche tools, sorted by use case, data-protection requirements and team size.

events.title: Kickstart AI Workflows with Databricks
events.organiser: Swiss Data & AI Group (Databricks User Group)
events.description: Hybrid Databricks user-group evening in Zurich on automating data work with AI-enabled workflows, including a session on Databricks Apps and Lakebase applied to clinical cancer research cohorts. Rescheduled from November 2026 to February 2027.

events.title: CERN PGDay 2027
events.cost: Ticketed (reduced rate for SwissPUG members and CERN staff and alumni)
events.organiser: Swiss PostgreSQL Users Group (SwissPUG) with CERN
events.description: A single-track, English-language PostgreSQL conference at CERN with seven sessions on high-performance and big-data workloads, AI and vector search with pgvector, enterprise security and compliance, and core database development, followed by a social evening.

events.title: KI-Stammtisch Rheintal #1 — Generative KI
events.organiser: thinking services ag, in partnership with swissAI
events.description: First of a new after-work round table for the Rheintal SME AI community — no stage talks, just participants swapping what generative AI really does in their day-to-day work, what does not work, and what they plan to try next.

events.title: Journée IA & Enseignement #2
events.venue: HEIA-FR Fribourg, Amphimax UNIL Lausanne, UNINE Neuchâtel and Campus Biotech UNIGE Geneva, plus online
events.organiser: HES-SO, UNIFR, UNIGE, UNIL, UNINE and swissuniversities
events.description: Second edition of the Swiss higher-education day on AI and teaching, running simultaneously on four university campuses with talks broadcast between the sites and online; an official pre-event on the road to the Geneva AI Summit.

events.title: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 10 — Voice AI
events.organiser: Markenkern AG and Code Crush GmbH, powered by GRdigital
events.description: Tenth edition of the Graubünden AI meetup in Chur, with Rico Castelberg on voice AI and digital telephone assistants, followed by open discussion and networking.

events.title: AI Days 2027 — Geneva
events.description: Geneva leg of the fifth AI Days, the Swiss AI Center’s applied-AI conference for SMEs, with workshops, talks, research and demos. Registration not yet open.

events.title: Composable Kubernetes Operators & Intent-Based Infrastructure
events.description: Tristan Smagghe of Infomaniak on designing composable Kubernetes operators that coordinate through contracts behind Infomaniak’s new hosting platform, then Torsten Boettjer on an open-source intent layer that lets operators and AI agents describe desired state and drive autonomous operations.

events.title: AI Days 2027 — Yverdon-les-Bains
events.description: Yverdon-les-Bains leg of AI Days 2027, the Swiss AI Center’s applied-AI conference for SMEs, with workshops, talks and demos. Registration not yet open.

events.title: AI Days 2027 — Fribourg
events.description: Fribourg leg of AI Days 2027, the Swiss AI Center’s applied-AI conference for SMEs, closing the three-city edition with workshops, talks and demos. Registration not yet open.

events.title: Voxxed Days Ticino 2027
events.cost: CHF 215 early bird, CHF 250 standard, CHF 99 student
events.description: A one-day developer conference in Lugano with nine tracks, including agentic engineering and tooling and a cloud native, data and infrastructure track, with optional hands-on workshops the day before.

events.title: Swiss Cyber Security Days 2027 — When AI Acts
events.description: Two-day conference and exhibition built around AI shifting from a supporting tool to an autonomous actor, with keynotes and panels on the resulting questions of trust, accountability and digital sovereignty.

events.title: GenAI Zürich 2027
events.description: A two-day European summit on applied generative AI at the Volkshaus: keynotes, panels, workshops, roundtables, a hackathon, startup pitches and the GenAI Zürich Award, focused on what works in production.

events.title: 3rd International Humanoid Forum
events.organiser: Switzerland Innovation Park Biel/Bienne (Swiss Smart Factory) with the Swiss Robotics Association
events.description: Two days on humanoid robots in industry — keynotes, panels, live demonstrations, hands-on sessions and matchmaking, with speakers from ETH Zurich, Idiap, Siemens, NEURA Robotics and AGIBOT.

events.title: KI-Stammtisch Rheintal #2 — Agentische KI
events.organiser: thinking services ag, in partnership with swissAI
events.description: Second Rheintal KI-Stammtisch, this time on AI agents: what they can already take over in a small or mid-sized company, which questions are still open, and what the people in the room have tried themselves.

events.title: Drupal Mountain Camp 2027 — Humans with AI in the Loop
events.description: Three days in Davos on open-source web platforms under the theme “Humans with AI in the Loop”, with an AI hackathon, workshops, two session tracks, contribution sprints and a fireside chat with Drupal founder Dries Buytaert.

events.title: IMD KI-Update 2027
events.cost: CHF 890 (CHF 623 per person for teams of five or more)
events.organiser: echo originals AG (with IMD as knowledge partner)
events.description: A one-day German-language management congress on leading in the AI era: executive cases, keynotes on efficiency, growth, trust and responsibility, and a closing keynote by Richard David Precht.

events.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — KI in der betrieblichen Marktforschung
events.cost: CHF 80 for Swiss Insights individual members, CHF 120 for non-members (excl. VAT)
events.description: German-language webinar with Karin Hagemann (S-Communication Services) on putting generative AI and agentic workflows to work in in-house research teams, including building small tools yourself and where the limits sit.

events.title: Swiss Legal Tech Conference 2027
events.description: A day of sessions on legal technology and AI in practice: comprehensive data management and whether data lakes break down silos, risk and exit management for legal tech, courts in the age of AI, and what role AI agents play today.

events.title: Voxxed Days CERN 2027
events.venue: CERN Science Gateway, Esplanade des Particules 1
events.cost: CHF 295 (conference pass; CERN tour option on 4 March)
events.organiser: Exteso Sagl, in collaboration with CERN
events.description: A one-day developer conference held at the CERN Science Gateway, with tracks on AI and agentic engineering, cloud native data and infrastructure, software architecture and modernisation, and an optional tour of CERN’s underground facilities.

events.title: Winterkongress 2027
events.description: Two-day non-commercial congress of the Digitale Gesellschaft with four tracks — digital self-defence, ethics and society, law and politics, and networks, security, hard- and software — covering data protection and AI policy; presale opens in mid-December.

events.title: WordCamp Switzerland 2027
events.description: The Swiss WordPress community conference, moved from September 2026 to the Centre Loewenberg campus near Murten: a contributor day on the Friday and a full day of community talks and networking on the Saturday.

events.title: AMLD Intelligence Summit 2027
events.organiser: EPFL AI Center (Applied Machine Learning Days)
events.description: The Applied Machine Learning Days return under a new name: two days of keynotes, tracks, demos, posters and an open stage for startup pitches on the move from generative AI to agentic systems in production, followed by a day of hands-on workshops.

events.title: AI Masterclass 2027 — Session 3
events.venue: Atrium, Campus SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4
events.description: Third of FER Genève's free 2027 lunchtime masterclasses, on bringing AI into teams and supporting day-to-day adoption.

events.title: Voxxed Days Zürich 2027
events.cost: CHF 301 early bird, CHF 360 standard, CHF 166 student
events.description: One-day developer conference at the Sihlcity cinemas with nine tracks, among them agentic engineering and tooling (agents, RAG, evals, LLMOps) and a cloud native, data and infrastructure track covering streaming, vector databases and model serving.

events.title: Webinar: Mehr Aha, weniger Warten – Feedback mit KI
events.description: Dan Vyleta, Director of Education at Brian, on using AI to give learners fast individual feedback on their work while the teacher keeps oversight of the process, followed by questions from the floor.

events.title: Pictet Hackathon 2027 — Agentic AI Meets Investment
events.description: A two-day hackathon in Geneva, run as an official side event of the Applied Machine Learning Days, where mixed teams of Pictet employees, students and external builders turn real financial-services challenges into working agentic-AI prototypes; applications close on 7 January 2027.

events.title: Software Engineering in der Vibe-Code-Ära
events.venue: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus St. Gallen, Raum FZ.0211
events.cost: CHF 600 (materials, refreshments and a follow-up online clinic included)
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.description: One-day German-language course for senior engineers, tech leads and CTOs who already code with agentic tools: build your own eval suite, an MCP tool wired to your build and test commands, a CI hook that blocks bad AI patches, and a cost-per-feature model comparison — working on your own repository. Limited to 16 participants.

events.title: DigiDay Bern 2027 — Digitale Souveränität
events.organiser: ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA Zürich, in cooperation with the Austrian Embassy in Bern
events.description: Day on digital sovereignty for the Swiss–Austrian e-government community, covering the government cloud, e-ID, cybersecurity, data governance and how AI is regulated and used across public administration and industry.

events.title: Webinar: Copilot und Datenschutz im Schulalltag
events.description: Daniel von Büren, Swiss Security Officer and Solution Engineer at Microsoft, on what Copilot does with the data put into it — where it is stored, who can reach it, and how to handle confidential information responsibly.

events.title: What Is a Public AI Register, and What Is It For?
events.cost: Not listed (by invitation, request to attend)
events.description: The fifth Road to Geneva afterwork, presenting the Geneva Register to permanent missions and asking what a public register of AI systems is actually for.

events.title: EY National AI Conference 2027
events.description: Fourth edition of EY Switzerland's national AI conference, staged as a 'Road to Geneva' event ahead of the Geneva AI Summit; the programme and registration are still to be published.
